source: CoBit COLM paper (cobit_colm_version.pdf), Figure 2 'LM1B GenPPL-entropy frontier', page 15
method: Read from the figure's vector paths (polyline vertices and marker centres), mapped to data with the gridlines (x: 4.24..4.34, y: 50..110). The six reference markers reproduce Table 1 to two decimals, which validates the mapping.
note: CoBit points are the plotted single sweep points; Table 1's 256-NFE rows are 10-seed means (deterministic 82.90 +/- 1.11 @ 4.30, stochastic 59.76 +/- 0.57 @ 4.31).

this_run.settings: released CoBit-S LM1B 1M checkpoint; NFE 256 (255 steps); gamma 0.200 full band; S_noise 1.003; ati_eta 0; seed 42 for every arm; 1024 samples; GPT-2 Large GenPPL; BERT unigram entropy
